<function name="SetSteering" parent="Vehicle" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Sets the steering of the vehicle.
<validate>The correct range, 0 to 1 or -1 to 1</validate>
	</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="front" type="number">Angle of the front wheels (-1 to 1)</arg>
		<arg name="rear" type="number">Angle of the rear wheels (-1 to 1)</arg>
	</args>
</function>
